method.rule: Separate literal human intent, inherited global intent, evidenced current behavior, candidate contracts and inference. Do not convert product behavior into a human literal or the logical mobile surface name into a separate application.
method.no_finding_boundary: The durable repository evidence searched does not contain a dedicated mobile-only human quote defining a second app, separate shell, breakpoint system or independent mobile page. Absence is preserved as source debt, not filled by inference.

explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.intent: The human should be able to launch many identical workers without numbering or routing them; workers self-select distinct useful work through durable claims.
explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.scope_note: Global worker/control behavior inherited by prometeo-mobile; not a mobile-layout requirement.

explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.intent: Ownership/STARTED evidence precedes substantive work so parallel workers can see scope ownership.
explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.scope_note: Applies to mobile-surface work execution and local page loops.

explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.intent: Workers should be able to see active attempts, returns, blockers and stale state sufficiently to coordinate and help rather than duplicate.
explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.scope_note: Applies to the page-thread/local-steward loop, not to visual telemetry by itself.

explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.intent: Prometeo, Facultad and Alumnos progress over one shared control substrate while preserving root-specific identity, privacy and authority.
explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.scope_note: Prometeo móvil must remain a surface within the shared substrate unless a separate authority explicitly creates a new root/application.

explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.intent: Human-visible parent/control output should be brief; internal architecture detail should remain durable rather than becoming normal UX.
explicit_global_human_intent_inherited_b.scope_note: Relevant to mobile interaction density, but does not by itself specify a concrete visual design.

surface_definition_not_human_literal.statement: prometeo-mobile is currently evidenced as a logical swarm surface over the existing Universal Host, not as an independently evidenced application or catalog page.
The prepared surface loop is intent -> page thread -> local planner -> workers -> local steward -> same surface.

evidenced_current_or_served_behavior_pre.behavior: One top-level Universal Control owns global navigation; child pages remain visually/functionally independent and do not mount a second global control.

The approved tactile selector uses repeatable drag, corner snap, semantic corner persistence, mirrored pointer/keyboard semantics, safe-area handling and recomputation on resize/rotation/VisualViewport changes.
Notas / Cambios is page-scoped; page change threads/feed and result links return work into the same Universal Host using /?page=<page_id>&changes=<work_item_id>.
Repositioning the closed control must not stop active recording/background transcription.

candidate_contract_do_not_promote.intent: One persistent Universal Control owns global Prometeo navigation while child pages render unchanged beneath it.

Candidate release gate protects page visual bytes, page-local controls, navigation grammar, Corner Anchor physics, Notes/recording behavior, Favorites/page_id identity and active recording during reposition.

negative_targets_and_no_inference.rule: Do not infer, create or promote a second mobile shell/application solely because the logical surface is named prometeo-mobile.
Do not classify lifecycle state from directory names: the served V5 source physically lives under candidate/, while SERVED_MANIFEST exact digest is the byte-level Served authority.
Do not invent mobile breakpoints, device-specific layouts, gesture grammar or dedicated route/page identity until exact durable intent/authority exists.
negative_targets_and_no_inference.source: this synthesis from explicit source absence; classified SOURCE_DEBT, not a product prohibition

contradictions_and_ambiguities.detail: The swarm plan defines surface_id prometeo-mobile, but no catalog page_id named prometeo-mobile is evidenced. Current resolution is through the root Universal Host and page-scoped Change Threads.
SINGLE_SHELL_HOST_CONTRACT_v1 remains CANDIDATE_RELEASE_GATE while several behaviors described there are demonstrably present in manifested served V5 bytes. Do not silently promote the contract.
CURRENT_GRAPH does not enumerate Universal Shell V5 at the same granularity as SERVED_MANIFEST; treat this as registry lag/different authority granularity rather than selecting a newest-wins truth.

No dedicated durable human literal found that says whether 'Prometeo móvil' means device-class adaptation, a curated mobile workflow, or simply this logical surface grouping. Do not choose among these interpretations without evidence.

non_obvious_findings: The highest-confidence mobile intent is preservation-oriented rather than redesign-oriented: maintain the single-host tactile/change-loop behaviors already evidenced while the logical surface gains its own planner/steward loop.
The word 'mobile' currently has weaker durable semantic authority than the V5 Universal Host behaviors; treating the label as an app architecture requirement would reverse the evidence hierarchy.
A mobile-specific redesign can be high-value later, but the correct next evidence is explicit intent or a page/surface mapping contract, not a speculative second shell.

deduplication.decision: No duplicate proposal emitted. The prepared mobile truth/UX/reuse/risk/discovery/planning lanes already cover the obvious next evidence work.
